test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_wide_integer ( k UInt64, d64 Decimal64(2), i128 Int128, u128 UInt128, d128 Decimal128(4), i256 Int256, u256 UInt256, d256 Decimal256(10), small_i128 Int128 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_wide_integer SELECT number % 100000, toDecimal64(toInt64(cityHash64(number, 1)) % 100000000000, 2), toInt128(bitShiftLeft(toUInt128(cityHash64(number, 3)), 64) + cityHash64(number, 4)), bitShiftLeft(toUInt128(cityHash64(number, 5)), 64) + cityHash64(number, 6), toDecimal128(toInt64(cityHash64(number, 7)) % 100000000000000, 4), toInt256(bitShiftLeft(toUInt256(cityHash64(number, 8)), 192) + bitShiftLeft(toUInt256(cityHash64(number, 9)), 128) + bitShiftLeft(toUInt256(cityHash64(number, 10)), 64) + cityHash64(number, 11)), bitShiftLeft(toUInt256(cityHash64(number, 12)), 192) + bitShiftLeft(toUInt256(cityHash64(number, 13)), 128) + bitShiftLeft(toUInt256(cityHash64(number, 14)), 64) + cityHash64(number, 15), toDecimal256(toInt64(cityHash64(number, 16)) % 100000000000000, 10), toInt128(toInt64(cityHash64(number, 17))) FROM numbers(5000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(d64) FROM t_wide_integer FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(u128), sum(i128), sum(d128) FROM t_wide_integer FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(u256), sum(i256), sum(d256) FROM t_wide_integer FORMAT Null
SELECT sumIf(d128, k % 3 = 0) FROM t_wide_integer FORMAT Null
SELECT sumIf(d256, k % 3 = 0) FROM t_wide_integer FORMAT Null
SELECT k, sum(d128), sum(d256), sum(small_i128) FROM t_wide_integer GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM t_wide_integer WHERE NOT ignore(i128 + small_i128)
SELECT count() FROM t_wide_integer WHERE NOT ignore(i128 - small_i128)
SELECT count() FROM t_wide_integer WHERE NOT ignore(u128 - k)
SELECT count() FROM t_wide_integer WHERE NOT ignore(i256 + small_i128)
SELECT count() FROM t_wide_integer WHERE NOT ignore(i256 - small_i128)
SELECT count() FROM t_wide_integer WHERE NOT ignore(u256 - k)
